name: Cloud Seeker
detailed_description:
“To be a Cloud Seeker is to drift adventurously like mist and answer with quiet courage.”

Step into the mist-shrouded world of Cloud Seeker, a 2D action-platformer inspired by the rich tapestry of Chinese mythology and culture. Journey distant lands in a quest to stop a primordial god, in a world where individuals worthy enough can be granted a position as one of the Legendary 12 Zodiacs. With the help of your allies in a unique companion system, reclaim the legacy of the Cloud Seeker.

Story

Long before time had a name, a race of the highest order was hosted by the ruler of heaven and earth. 12 animals were selected to participate in the race. These went on to become the Legendary Zodiacs, and were supposedly bestowed mythical powers contained in relics known as Cyclical Sigils. Every 100 years, a festival would occur to determine the successors to the Zodiacs.

Yun, a charismatic, playful and overconfident rabbit, has been shortlisted to be next in line to be the Cloud Seeker, the title given to the original Rabbit Zodiac. However, due to his often cocky attitude, he is deemed unfit to bear such a responsibility yet, until a crisis unfolds when the primordial chaos, Hundun, gets broken free by a clan of termites who worship the being.

Features

⦁ A vast, interconnected world filled with secrets and lore. Explore and discover to your heart's content!

⦁ Finely tuned controls fit for combat and exploration.

⦁ Harvest materials from foes and the environment to craft various items and weapons.

⦁ Meet companions that join your side and enhance exploration and storytelling. Unleash the power of Qi with a powerful fist punch or defend yourself in a pinch with protective magic.

⦁ Encounter a wide variety of enemy types, from termite bandits to mythical beasts and divine entities drawn from Chinese folklore!

⦁ A stylized, hand-crafted aesthetic, with 2D animated characters and NPCs.
